# Description

This form provides for the reporting of the total annual numbers of fishing vessels involved in operation by type of fishing vessel, configuration, mechanisation, onboard fish preservation, and size class.

For each stratum, the data coverage -- i.e., the percentage (%) of vessels or fishing activities sampled -- derived from the coverage type must be reported to assess the representativeness and quality of the estimates.

Click [here](./Form-2FC.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form 2FC, or [return](./index.html) to the list of IOTC statistical data reporting forms.

# Data Content

Number of fishing vessel by size category, along with information on the value (%) and type of sampling coverage used for the estimations by year, fleet, fishery, and vessel characteristics.

# Stratification

## General Information

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value  |
|:-----------------|:-------------:|:--------------------- |:----- | :------------------ |
| Reporting year | M | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer | | 
| Reporting entity | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | **Code** from [Entities](#entities) | e.g., `EUR` | 
| Flag state | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the country registration of the fishery vessels | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |

## Main Data Elements

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:-----------------|:-------------:|:--------------------- |:-----| :------------------ |
| Vessel type | M | Type of fishing vessel according to primary gear or operational function | **Code** from [Vessel types](#vesselTypes) | e.g., `LP` | 

## Original Data

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:-----------------|:-------------:|:--------------------- |:-----| :------------------ |
| Original data type | M | Preliminary/final status of the data | **Code** from [Types of data](#dataTypes) | e.g., `FI` | 
| Original data source | M | Source of information | **Code** from [Fishing craft data sources](#sourcesFC) | e.g., `GV` |
| Original data processing | M | Processing applied to the data | **Code** from [Fishing craft data processings](#dataProcessingsFC) | e.g., `OR` |
| Source coverage type | M | Variable used for data coverage | **Code** from [Types of coverage](#coverageTypes) | e.g., `BO` |

## Vessel Characteristics

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:-----------------|:-------------:|:--------------------- |:-----| :------------------ |
| Architecture | M | Type fishing vessel based on structural design and construction type | **Code** from [Vessel architectures](#vesselArchitectures) | e.g., `PIRG` |
| Mechanisation type | M | Type of vessel mechanisation| **Code** from [Mechanisation types](#mechanisationTypes) | e.g., `MO` | 
| Vessel size types | M | Type of vessel size | **Code** from [Vessel size types](#vesselSizeTypes) | e.g., `GT` |
| Fish preservation method | M | Type of preservation methods being used for target species onboard vessels | **Code** from [Fish preservation methods](#fishPreservationMethods) | e.g., `IC` |
| Fish storage | M | Type of structures present on-board and used by the vessel to store the catch | **Code** from [Fish storage method](#fishStorageTypes) | e.g., `IC` |

# Reporting Metadata

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Liaison officer full name | M  | Name of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | String | e.g., `John Doe` |
| Liaison officer email	 | M | Email address of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `John.Doe@fao.org` |
| Organisation name | M | Name of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | String | e.g., `National Institute of Fisheries` |
| Organisation email | O | Email address of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | e.g., `nif@gov.sc` |
| Finalisation date | M | Date of finalisation of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | e.g., `1996-03-27` |
| Submission date | O | Date of submission of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | e.g. `1997-03-21` |

# Reporting Deadlines

+ **Longline fisheries**: 30 June (preliminary), 30 December (final)
+ **Surface fisheries**: 30 June (final)
+ **Coastal fisheries**: 30 June (final)
